title: Pre-Emergent + Penetrant, Bunker Faces
sheet_name: Bunkers - Pre-Emergent + Penetrant App (10 Nov), 1.3 ha
checks: Tank, hose and gun rinsed since the last load
Residue in the hose can damage the next job
Suction and gun filters clean, lid seal good
Hose and reel: no cracks, kinks or leaks
Gun trigger, lock and fishmouth nozzle work, no drips
Gun output: spray into a bucket for 30 s at 4 bar, double it for L/min
1000 L/ha is 10 L per 10 × 10 m. At 10 L/min that's 1 minute per 10 × 10 m of bunker face
Fill hose above the water line
Spill kit, wash water and eyewash on the rig
Labels and SDSs for Barricade and Pervade with you
Spray signs out where you're working
Barricade label: wind 3–20 km/h and no inversion. Don't start until Delta T is over 2
extra_checks: A little blue dye in the tank
So you can see where you've sprayed
Barricade's label says not on putting greens
ppe_note: Barricade label: cotton overalls buttoned to the neck and wrist, elbow-length chemical-resistant gloves and a washable hat for hand-wand work. Goggles when you pour the Pervade.
spray_rules: Faces only: from up under the lip down to where the raked base starts. No bases, unless it's a bad fairway bunker with lots of weeds in the base
Do the bunkers not sprayed Monday. Monday's ticks are on the bunker map: andranf.github.io/ranfurlie-greens/spray/bunker-map/
Keep it off greens and collars. Barricade's label says not on putting greens
Nozzle no higher than 50 cm, coarse spray, 4 bar. Wind 3–20 km/h: stop if it's blowing toward a green
Don't start until Delta T is over 2
Never spray near golfers: work in the gaps behind groups
Keep people off until it's dry. Write down which bunkers you did: they need 6 mm of water within 7 days
spray_more: Barricade label: at least 500 L/ha water, wind 3–20 km/h, no inversion, nozzle no higher than 50 cm, COARSE droplets or larger, not on greens or stressed turf, don't apply if heavy rain is forecast within 48 h. Water in with at least 6 mm within 7 days, no irrigation to run-off for 3 days. No overseeding with cool-season grass for 6 months. Pervade: water in well.
post_checks: Tank sprayed out on the bunker faces
Hose and gun flushed with clean water
Sprayed out on a bunker face you treated
They need 6 mm of water within 7 days
post_fields: Paste the list from the bunker map (Copy list for the checklist)

flags.t: Barricade 4 L/ha is above its spring summer-grass rate
flags.d: Label: most established turf (couch, kikuyu, buffalo) 1–3 L/ha in early spring for summer grass and crowsfoot. 4 L/ha sits in the label only for paspalum (2–4 L/ha) and for winter grass in high-risk areas such as greens surrounds (4 L/ha, late summer to early autumn). Built at the sheet rates over 1.3 ha (Andy, 9 Nov: the sheet's 0.5 ha was GreenKeeper's estimate).

flags.t: Needs 6 mm of water within 7 days
flags.d: Barricade's label: at least 6 mm of rain or irrigation within 7 days, and no irrigation to run-off for 3 days. Pervade also wants watering in. About 4 mm of showers is forecast over the next 7 days (Sat–Sun), so the bunker faces need irrigation, Monday's and today's. Michael logs which bunkers he did on the checklist.

flags.t: No overseeding the bunker faces for 6 months
flags.d: Barricade label: don't overseed with cool-season grass for 6 months after application.
Floratine's rate is 2.5–5 L/ha in 600–800 L/ha water, watered in well. 5 L/ha is the top of the range; 1000 L/ha is more water than it asks for, which suits a soil pass.

flags.t: Sign-off will record the rig as 'Other'
flags.d: The sign-off workflow knows Silvan 1000 L and 600 L but not the 2000 L, so the Notion record shows the sprayer as Other. Everything else records normally.
